name: Castlevania
description: A vampire hunter fights to save a besieged city from an army of otherworldly beasts controlled by Dracula himself.

videos.title: Witchbottle
videos.overview: A headstrong young woman seeks out forbidden knowledge, and a corrupt bishop courts disaster by enraging a legend.

videos.title: Necropolis
videos.overview: Trevor Belmont drifts into the panicked city of Gresit, where he learns of an ancient evil and makes a surprising vow.

videos.title: Labyrinth
videos.overview: Belmont explores the catacombs of Gresit and makes a disturbing discovery. As night falls on the city, the beasts return for blood.

videos.title: Monument
videos.overview: Belmont strives to save Gresit from certain doom and comes face to face with a shocking truth.

videos.title: War Council
videos.overview: Dracula entrusts a deadly -- and personal -- mission with two humans who truly hate humanity, not knowing that he himself has become a target.

videos.title: Old Homes
videos.overview: As Belmont shares a bold strategy with Alucard and Sypha, Dracula addresses a conflict within his ranks. Isaac recalls a painful encounter.

videos.title: Shadow Battles
videos.overview: Belmont travels to his family's archives, along with Sypha and a cynical Alucard. Godbrand voices a suspicion about Dracula's motives.

videos.title: Broken Mast
videos.overview: As Godbrand's thirst grows stronger, Carmilla tries to recruit Hector. Isaac shows his loyalty, and Belmont shares a family story with Sypha.

videos.title: Last Spell
videos.overview: Carmilla presses forward with her plan despite Godbrand's disappearance. Sypha makes a startling discovery while combing the archives.

videos.title: The River
videos.overview: Does he really have what it takes to live up to his family's reputation? It's time for Belmont to pick his fate. Also, Dracula prepares for the fight.

videos.title: For Love
videos.overview: With nothing less than the future of humanity at stake, Belmont, Alucard and Sypha do battle with their immortal enemy: Dracula.

videos.title: End Times
videos.overview: With the war between humans and vampires seemingly settled, the survivors -- both good and evil -- look toward the future.

videos.title: Bless Your Dead Little Hearts
videos.overview: Alucard adjusts to his lonely new life, Belmont and Sypha pay a visit to an eerie and unusual town, and Carmilla returns home with a prize.

videos.title: The Reparation of My Heart
videos.overview: Isaac gets some unexpected help in his search for Hector. Meanwhile, Carmilla plots a land grab and Alucard meets some fans.

videos.title: Investigators
videos.overview: Belmont and Sypha's plan to leave Lindenfeld hits a snag. Isaac and the Captain debate the merits of humanity. Hector tries to get a read on Lenore.

videos.title: I Have a Scheme
videos.overview: Sumi and Taka share their history with Alucard. Also, Saint Germain gains entrance to the priory, and Isaac receives an icy welcome in Genoa.

videos.title: A Seat of Civilisation and Refinement
videos.overview: Belmont and the Judge discover an ominous symbol, Saint Germain's treasure hunt is cut short, and Alucard's bond with Sumi and Taka continues to grow.

videos.title: The Good Dream
videos.overview: Lenore continues to spend time with Hector, slowly earning his trust. Saint Germain experiences a telling nightmare about the Infinite Corridor.

videos.title: Worse Things Than Betrayal
videos.overview: As Saint Germain makes unsettling discoveries, Isaac marches toward a showdown. Meanwhile, Belmont and Sypha question a monk — aggressively.

videos.title: What the Night Brings
videos.overview: Something is alive in the priory's basement, and for Belmont and Sypha, time is of the essence. Lenore opens up to Hector about Carmilla's plans.

videos.title: The Harvest
videos.overview: Night falls on Lindenfeld and all manner of hell breaks loose. Also, Isaac meets the Magician, Hector makes a pledge, and Sumi and Taka make a move.

videos.title: Abandon All Hope
videos.overview: With the portal to hell open, Trevor and Sypha must battle an onslaught. Meanwhile, the Judge shares a disturbing legacy, and Hector learns his fate.

videos.title: Murder Wakes It Up
videos.overview: Belmont and Sypha continue to battle beasts loyal to Dracula, but it's getting a little old. Meanwhile, Alucard receives a guest.

videos.title: Having the World
videos.overview: Lenore urges Hector to not test Carmilla's patience. Belmont and Sypha cross paths with Zamfir, a fearsome guard with a suspicious mind.

videos.title: Walk Away
videos.overview: Isaac gets under Varney's skin. Vampires Morana and Striga receive an urgent message from Carmilla. Belmont and Sypha get a look at Targoviste.

videos.title: You Must Sacrifice
videos.overview: Alucard travels to Danesti, where he makes a dramatic entrance in the nick of time. Also, the scholar Saint Germain reflects on his own twisted path.

videos.title: Back in the World
videos.overview: With Greta's help, Alucard sets out to guide the villagers to his castle for protection. Sypha pushes back on Zamfir's leadership. Isaac makes a move.

videos.title: You Don't Deserve My Blood
videos.overview: As Isaac and his army of night creatures descend on Carmilla's castle, Hector rushes to finish his preparations before the bloody reunion begins.

videos.title: The Great Work
videos.overview: Varney and Ratko discover their plan is working — but who gets the credit? Also, Zamfir finally takes Belmont and Sypha underground.

videos.title: Death Magic
videos.overview: Belmont, Sypha and Zamfir battle Varney, Ratko and their unholy army. Alucard's castle falls under attack, and Saint Germain shares his scheme.

videos.title: The Endings
videos.overview: Belmont and Sypha join forces with their old friend Alucard — and not a moment too soon. As the battle rages, Varney reveals his true form.

videos.title: It's Been a Strange Ride
videos.overview: Not content to live in a cage, Lenore chooses another fate. Alucard opens his castle. Sypha wonders if she's lost Belmont for good.
